dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.name: Break of Dawn
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.description: At sunrise, the hero gains increased vision and base damage.
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.scepter_description: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.name: Starbreaker
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.lore: Among countless starborn heirs, many refused to follow the will of the Children of Radiance. To those who dared resist, the Children sent hammer-wielding Valor to show their power — and the dissenters either met their downfall or returned to the true path.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.description: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note0: While using this ability, the hero moves at %movement_speed%, and recovers from the final swing after %self_stun_duration% sec.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note1: Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be used while this ability is active.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note2: Attacks from this ability do not trigger cleave.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note3: Can be cast on self to move forward.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note4: The first two swings slow enemies by %swipe_slow%% for %sweep_stun_duration% sec.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.swipe_damage: BONUS DAMAGE FROM SWINGS AND SMASH:
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.shard_description: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.facet_dawnbreaker_blaze: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.

descriptions.swipe_damage: BONUS DAMAGE FROM SWINGS AND SMASH:

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.name: Celestial Hammer
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.lore: Only the hammer, Lucent — Valor's oldest companion — connects her to the radiance of the creators.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_gleaming_hammer: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.description: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note0: The hammer damages enemies both on the throw and on the return.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note1: The hero's flight distance cannot exceed the range of this ability.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note2: Starbreaker cannot be used if the hero does not have the hammer in hand.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_hearthfire: Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_brightmaul_wake: Enemies hit by Celestial Hammer will count as Luminosity attacks. Luminosity's crit will apply to Celestial Hammer.

dawnbreaker_luminosity.name: Luminosity
dawnbreaker_luminosity.lore: Valor is weakened without the reinforcing light of the Children of Radiance, yet she can still empower allies, bringing order to the chaos inherent in every battle.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.description: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.scepter_description: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.facet_dawnbreaker_solar_charged: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.note0: Healing from this ability is increased by lifesteal.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.note1: Receiving effects is disabled by exhaustion.

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.name: Solar Guardian
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.lore: Valor is willing to call upon the last remnants of her former strength to soar on the wings of the cosmos, solely to protect her allies.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.description:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.note1: The ability takes %abilitychanneltime% sec. to cast and %airtime_duration% sec. to fly.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.note2: Cannot be cast without the hammer.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.scepter_description: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
